change.what_changed: Initial publication of the seven-subcategory Seafood standard (marine predatory, marine non-predatory, freshwater, shellfish, cephalopods, seaweed & kelp foods, canned seafood) under the government-limit default (Method v2.0), with species-specific dual-mercury limits and adversarial-audit verification. Consolidated PDF in preparation; a DOI is minted on deposit.
